sub_graphs.title: Fulu Fork: Beacon State Upgrade Transition
sub_graphs.description: Models the state migration from Electra to Fulu consensus state format at the fork boundary epoch

nodes.label: Beacon State in Electra Format
nodes.description: The beacon chain is running with Electra-format state, approaching FULU_FORK_EPOCH

nodes.label: Check Fork Epoch Condition
nodes.description: Evaluate whether current slot aligns with epoch boundary (slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH == 0) and epoch equals FULU_FORK_EPOCH

nodes.label: Execute upgrade_to_fulu
nodes.description: Perform irregular state change: copy all Electra fields, set fork version to 0x06000000, update previous_version to Electra version, set fork epoch

nodes.label: Initialize Proposer Lookahead
nodes.description: Compute proposer indices for (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1) * SLOTS_PER_EPOCH slots starting from current epoch and populate the new proposer_lookahead field

nodes.label: Beacon State in Fulu Format
nodes.description: The beacon chain is now running with Fulu-format state including the proposer_lookahead field

nodes.label: Fork Condition Not Met
nodes.description: Epoch boundary check fails; state remains in Electra format and normal processing continues

edges.label: At each epoch boundary, check if FULU_FORK_EPOCH reached
edges.condition: At each epoch boundary, check if FULU_FORK_EPOCH reached

sub_graphs.title: Fulu Fork: Fork Version and State Integrity Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation checks ensuring fork version correctness and field preservation during the Electra-to-Fulu upgrade

nodes.label: Electra State Fields Loaded
nodes.description: All Electra beacon state fields are available for migration: validators, balances, participation records, sync committees, execution payload, pending operations

nodes.label: Copy All Existing Fields
nodes.description: Transfer every Electra state field to the new Fulu state object preserving historical integrity and validator continuity

nodes.label: Set Fork Metadata
nodes.description: Set current_version to FULU_FORK_VERSION (0x06000000), previous_version to ELECTRA_FORK_VERSION, and epoch to FULU_FORK_EPOCH

nodes.label: Fork Metadata Committed
nodes.description: Fork object in state reflects Fulu version with correct previous version and epoch references

nodes.label: Validate Fork Version on Attestation/Block
nodes.description: Post-fork, any block or attestation must reference FULU_FORK_VERSION in its domain computation for signature verification

nodes.label: Signature Domain Valid for Fulu
nodes.description: Signature domain uses correct Fulu fork version, ensuring post-fork messages are authenticated against the right fork

edges.label: All fields copied, now update fork metadata

sub_graphs.title: Fulu Fork: Proposer Lookahead and Block Production
sub_graphs.description: Models how the new proposer_lookahead field affects block production scheduling after the Fulu fork

nodes.label: Proposer Lookahead Not Yet Computed
nodes.description: During upgrade, the proposer_lookahead field does not yet exist in the state

nodes.label: Compute Proposer Indices for Lookahead Window
nodes.description: Calculate which validators will propose blocks for (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1) * SLOTS_PER_EPOCH upcoming slots using the current epoch's seed

nodes.label: Proposer Lookahead Available
nodes.description: The proposer_lookahead field is populated with validator indices for the full lookahead window

nodes.label: Select Block Proposer from Lookahead
nodes.description: For each slot, read the assigned proposer index from the lookahead array instead of computing it on-the-fly

nodes.label: Proposer Assigned for Slot
nodes.description: A specific validator is designated as the block proposer for the current slot

external_entities.name: Validator Client
external_entities.description: External validator software that queries the beacon node for proposer duty assignments to know when to produce blocks

ambiguities.text: The specification does not explicitly describe what happens if a node encounters the fork epoch while syncing from a historical state (i.e., during initial sync or checkpoint sync).
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume that the fork upgrade function is applied during state replay whenever processing the slot at FULU_FORK_EPOCH boundary, regardless of whether the node is syncing or live. This follows the pattern of previous Ethereum fork upgrades.

ambiguities.text: The term 'irregular state change' is used to describe the fork transition without a precise definition of how it interacts with the normal epoch processing pipeline.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'irregular state change' means the upgrade function is called after normal epoch processing at the fork epoch boundary, as an additional step outside the standard state transition function. This is consistent with prior fork specs.

ambiguities.text: No explicit error handling is described for the case where initialize_proposer_lookahead fails or produces an empty result (e.g., if validator set is empty).
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the validator set is always non-empty at FULU_FORK_EPOCH since genesis requires a minimum validator count, and that initialize_proposer_lookahead is guaranteed to succeed under normal conditions.

implicit_assumptions.description: All beacon chain client implementations will apply the fork upgrade at exactly the same epoch boundary, ensuring network-wide consensus on the transition point.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If clients disagree on fork timing, a chain split occurs with validators on different fork versions unable to validate each other's blocks and attestations.

implicit_assumptions.description: The proposer_lookahead computation is deterministic given the same state, so all nodes will derive identical proposer assignments.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Non-deterministic proposer assignment would cause nodes to disagree on valid block proposers, leading to consensus failure and potential denial of service.

implicit_assumptions.description: Node operators will upgrade their client software before FULU_FORK_EPOCH (epoch 411392) to support the new state format.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Nodes running pre-Fulu software will reject post-fork blocks, fall out of consensus, and may follow a minority chain or stall entirely.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot manipulate the randomness seed used by initialize_proposer_lookahead to bias proposer selection at the fork boundary.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: An attacker could pre-compute favorable proposer assignments at fork time, potentially gaining disproportionate block production rights in the initial Fulu epoch.
